name: Clore Furniture
old_description: The Clore Family has lived and worked in the heart of Virginia since 1830, doing what they love and doing it very well. Through the years, Clore heirloom-quality furniture has come to be regarded as quintessentially American—functional, beautiful, and enduring.
about:
Clore Furniture operates from Madison, Virginia, where the Clore family has been crafting furniture since 1830. The business remains family-owned, with Troy Coppage serving as company president. The enterprise began as a multigenerational workshop in the heart of Virginia, building pieces intended to last for generations.

The company produces handcrafted furniture using traditional fabrication methods, offering a range of woods, finishes, and custom design options. In addition to new pieces, Clore provides restoration services for existing furniture. The workshop handles both standard catalog items and customized commissions, though specific production volumes and facility size are not disclosed.

Clore serves residential customers through its showroom and caters to institutional clients, as indicated by a dedicated institutions section. The firm emphasizes longstanding relationships with clients who value heirloom-quality pieces built for real-life use.

The company distinguishes itself through a commitment to sustainable sourcing and a philosophy that each piece is built as if it were destined for the craftsmen's own homes. This approach, maintained over more than 180 years, underpins its reputation for functional, beautiful, and enduring American furniture.
built_on: Each piece built as if for the craftsmen's own homes
type_evidence: "We've been handcrafting furniture for more than 180 years. Our skilled craftsmen build each piece as if it were going into their own homes. Clore furniture is built for real life."
